text:
lane: Heads-up, getting reports of intermittent 401/403 from our SCIM endpoint after the OIDC provider change. Error in logs: "invalid audience claim" and a few KMS decrypt fails for provisioned service keys. Anyone on call?

priya: I see the same. Quick grep shows newer SAML->OIDC bridge is issuing aud `https://idp.bridge/` while our token validator expects `https://auth.redwood/api` (old audience). That's why we get invalid aud.

ethan: Confirmed. Also KMS audit shows a short window where `scim-service` had no decrypt grant after the recent key rekey job. Two things at once. :grimacing:

lane: Oof. Could cause duplicate accounts if extId can't decrypt. Priya, can we add an audience alias for the validator? Quick fix.

priya: Yes, can add alias in the token validation config. Doing a hot reload now: `TOKEN_VALIDATOR_ACCEPTED_AUD=[https://auth.redwood/api,https://idp.bridge/]`

okta-bot: note: SCIM provisioning worker retried 9 users -> 3 failed with decrypt error, 6 failed with aud mismatch.

kms-bot: alert: grant removal detected for key `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abcd-rot-2026` at 2026-03-19T02:11:00Z. Principal affected: `scim-service`

ethan: I'm reapplying the KMS grant now. Reapplying by grant id is faster: `aws kms create-grant --key-id abcd --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111:role/scim-service --operations Decrypt`

lane: Security note: reapplying grants without audit ticket is OK for emergency, but record in incident tracker. Also check if rotation script removed grants during key import.

priya: Token validator hot reload worked. aud errors drop to zero in logs now.

ethan: KMS grant reapply confirmed. Retried the 9 users via staging worker, all succeeded.

lane: Two parallel action items:
- short: add aud alias and KMS grant reapply (done)
- medium: update rotation pipeline to preserve grants and test decrypt with `scim-service` after rotation
- long: align email canonicalization to lowercase full local@domain to avoid dupes from case variance

security-audit-bot: audit note: please attach PR/patch and list of affected orgs to INC-2026-21 for compliance review.

priya: Filing INC-2026-21 now, linking job logs and KMS CloudTrail entries. Also adding a unit test in integration that validates token audiences for the new bridge.

ethan: For the rotation pipeline patch: add `--preserve-grants` flag in the rekey tool and run a validation step: `python infra/kms/validate_rekey.py --principal scim-service --key-id new` which will attempt a decrypt of a known ciphertext and fail loudly if permission missing.

lane: Good. Also, let's update SCIM worker to exponential backoff and dedup heuristic: when decrypt fails, don't immediately create user - keep in retry queue until decrypt succeeds or TTL expires. That should stop duplicates during transient KMS issues.

priya: Will open small PR for backoff + dedup in scim-provisioning. tagging @security-compliance for review in the PR description.

lane: Anything else? We should do a quick vuln-triage: check if key rotation script had a recent change that removed preserve-grants behavior. Ethan, can you bisect?

ethan: Bisect points to infra change 2026-03-15 `rekey` rewrite. It defaulted to not copying grants. Created infra-issue INFRA-1427.

lane: Perfect. Patch INFRA-1427 with preserve-grants and add the decrypt validation step. Assign to infra owner.

security-audit-bot: tagging required: security-compliance, infra-team. Record saved to INC-2026-21.

priya: Monitoring looks clean after fixes. Will re-run a small repro for 200 orgs tomorrow in low traffic window.

lane: Thanks everyone. Postmortem and runbook updates required. I'll draft the postmortem and link affected CT logs + KMS trail. Closing thread after PM posts it.

ethan: Added follow-up checklist to INFRA-1427 and INC-2026-21. closing. :white_check_mark:
